name: session-begin-mints-a-token-and-a-path-keyed-cut
description: POST /session/begin over two tracked paths the coordinator has never seen. Each read-set path is seeded as a first observation (version 1, like pre-read), and the response carries the server-minted `session_token`, the PATH-keyed cut (artifact ids stay server-internal), the per-boot `coordinator_epoch`, and `retain_versions` -- false on the default coordinator, which tells the client a later /session/read answers `data_plane_deferred` rather than serving bytes. Both minted values are scrubbed by name to `<MINTED>` (#193 ask 2): the keys are asserted present, their per-run values are not compared.
